text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Who would've thought such romance 
was buried in a place like that!
choice_data_list: Romance...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! You should come with us too—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: To the "Get Rich Quick Shrine"!
choice_data_list: A shrine that can make you filthy rich!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pray at midnight, and happiness will come! 
A billionaire in the blink of an eye... 
It's a shrine with miraculous blessings 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How about that, gets your heart racing, 
doesn't it?! You gotta board this ship!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting a shrine at night... I feel a 
little uneasy. I have to make sure both of 
them stay safe.
choice_data_list: Of course! But only until curfew, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyo, hyoee~...! To think there's a shrine 
deep in such a creepy mountain...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
P-Please be careful! If it's an old 
shrine, spirits might gather there more 
easily...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That sounds great. If it's a jolly 
ghost, maybe we could throw a party—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list:
...? I thought I saw something fall from 
above...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I strain my eyes and look toward the 
sound. Lying on the ground is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the bloody head of a traditional 
Japanese doll.

text_block_list.name: Tap & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —Yikes!? —Fungyaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, come on... You've gotta be 
kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, an evil spirit?! Or a vengeful 
ghost?! It must be angry at us for 
approaching the shrine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud-thud-thud!)
choice_data_list: N-Now there are heads everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Holy crap! What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! S-Save me~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! Fukukitaru... !?
choice_data_list: L-Let's hurry and go after them!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I finally caught up...! Are you okay?! 
Wait—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That shrine building... Wait, isn't this 
the shrine we were looking for!?
choice_data_list:
Wait, there's something deep inside the 
shrine—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Straining my eyes in the dark— I saw 
headless Japanese dolls lined up in a row.
...Le-Leave... your head behind...

LEAVEYOURHEADLEAVEYOURHEADLEAVEYOUR 
HEADLEAVEYOURHEADLEAVEYOURHEADLEAV 
EYOURHEADLEAVEYOURHEADLEAVEYOURHEAD

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyawaaaa~~~!!? I-I'm so sorry, so sorry~!
choice_data_list: L-Let's run away right now...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Guess you were right, Trainer. No 
matter how you look at it, this thing is 
bad news...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yet—until I hold that treasure in my 
hands, there is no turning back for me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Look! The treasure island called a shrine 
is already right before our eyes!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No matter the storm, let's laugh it off 
and forge ahead! Right, Navigator?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
An evil spirit, you say? ...Hah! Bring it 
on.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If there's something you want, take it by 
force! That's our way of doing things!
choice_data_list: I'll keep moving forward with you!
I'll move forward together with you too!
Alright, let's figure out a plan.
Still, I can't put you two in danger...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If there's something you want, take it by 
force! That's our way of doing things!
choice_data_list: I'll keep moving forward with you!
I'll move forward together with you too!
Alright, let's figure out a plan.
Still, I can't put you two in danger...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's my first mate! I knew you'd say 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I'll go too! Ah, but could you 
two please take the lead...!
—Oh? Who might you folks be...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
I see, a doll's head fell down in the 
woods, and you fled all the way to our 
shrine... That sounds—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a trick I set up for the test 
of courage! Haha, my apologies for 
startling you so.
choice_data_list: A-A test of courage...!?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
The haunted house asked us to hold a 
memorial service for these dolls, so I 
thought we could all see it through 
together after the courage test.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
If you conquer your fear and offer a 
prayer, you'll strike it rich... or so the 
premise goes. Never thought I'd forget to 
turn off the power, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then, there really aren't any evil 
spirits...!? Thank goodneeeess!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What a shame. I thought I'd get to 
encounter some truly special romantic 
adventure.
choice_data_list:
You really mustered up your courage and 
tried to push forward.

You gathered your courage and tried to 
move forward, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well! I knew it was dangerous, but I 
was totally thrilled too, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The sketchier it is, the bigger the 
treasure waiting at the end has gotta be! 
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
If you conquer your fear and offer a 
prayer, you'll strike it rich... or so the 
premise goes. Never thought I'd forget to 
turn off the power, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Th-Then what about 'The Shrine 
That Makes You Super Rich'...!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What a shame! Did my romance just get 
washed away by the waves, too...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh... But since we came all this way! 
I'll pray for a blessing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Praying that someday, Tap Dance City 
would seize treasures of gold and 
silver..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: All right! So Trainer, what's the plan...?
choice_data_list:
For example, preparing a talisman to ward 
off evil...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I-In that case, leave it to me! 
Just in case something like this happened—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Created with Windy-san's lion dance as a 
motif —"Happy Chomp-Chomp Lion Dance-san"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. Lion Dance can gobble up any 
misfortune in one bite! Now then, let's 
offer our coins once again—"
—Oh? Who might you folks be...?

text_block_list.text:
Are you worried about me? ...Please, don't 
stop me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The compass in my heart is always pointing 
toward romance, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mgyaaah?! Y-You're gonna get cursed, 
Tap-san!
choice_data_list: I've gotta go stop them right away...!
